hooks.command: sh -c 'd="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; s="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"; case "$s" in *[!abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789._-]*) s="" ;; esac; m=""; if [ -n "$s" ]; then if [ -f "$d/.mmry-formation-$s" ]; then m=1; fi; else for f in "$d"/.mmry-formation-*; do case "${f##*/}" in .mmry-formation-cs-*) continue ;; .mmry-formation-poll-*) continue ;; .mmry-formation-handover-*) continue ;; .mmry-formation-renewed-*) continue ;; esac; if [ -f "$f" ]; then m=1; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -n "$m" ]; then if [ -f ~/.claude/mmry/hooks-handlers/hook-guard.sh ]; then exec bash ~/.claude/mmry/hooks-handlers/hook-guard.sh formation-check; fi; fi; exit 0'
